title: God Makes It Possible
truth: God can do anything, and He makes a way for us to be with Him through Jesus.
points: Jesus shows us that nothing is too hard for God.
Even when we can't do something, God can.
God helps us when we trust in Him.
apply: When you feel something is too hard, remember that God is with you and can help you. Ask Him to show you His way.
prayer: God, thank You that You are powerful and can do all things. Help me to trust You today.
